text: Mina said, “I can fill the apple bag.” Mrs Dutta said, “I need to catch the bus.” Mina borrowed the brass scale. Mina weighed the apple bag. Mina located the leaf under the brass scale's pan. The apple bag was underweight. Mina said, “I am wrong.” Mrs Dutta said, “I could wait.” Mina removed the leaf. Mina weighed the apple bag again. The apple bag was full. Mina handed Mrs Dutta the apple bag. Mina returned the brass scale to the olive stall. The brass scale's dial rested at zero.
